summary: Short, nearly flat corner kerb; house about 12 m behind trees.

best_section.where: South kerb beside the corner, in front of the tree-covered garden

drivers.seclusion: Dense trees screen a house 12-13 m back; homes opposite and around the corner.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide sealed street at a junction; room for a van off the corner.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street with a side-street junction.
drivers.convention: Cars park along the kerb to the east, so a van would blend in.

sun_shade: Dense tree canopy shades the kerb from the south.
